### Sylvamo to Release Third Quarter Earnings Nov. 6


October 6, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s28.q4cdn.com/627430382/files/doc_news/Sylvamo-to-Release-Third-Quarter-Earnings-Nov--6-2026.pdf)


MEMPHIS, Tenn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Sylvamo (NYSE: SLVM), the world’s paper company, will release third quarter earnings before the market opens Friday, Nov. 6.


The company will host an audio webcast at 10 a.m. EST at[investors.sylvamo.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.sylvamo.com%2F&esheet=54613761&newsitemid=20261006816749&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.sylvamo.com&index=1&md5=0ec9da5c58142065053463b0887c9304) .


To participate in Q&A, use the[analyst registration](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fanalyst%2F963339368%3Fpwd%3DNl32gKU4&esheet=54613761&newsitemid=20261006816749&lan=en-US&anchor=analyst+registration&index=2&md5=1c2dc3ffb56fbd06fc3e56cd64e836aa) to receive a unique passcode.


Replays will be available at[investors.sylvamo.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.sylvamo.com%2F&esheet=54613761&newsitemid=20261006816749&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.sylvamo.com&index=3&md5=4fa3a9ed67e5e5cc51a892a14b81bc76) for one year.


**About Sylvamo**


Sylvamo (NYSE: SLVM) is the world’s paper company with mills in Europe, Latin America and North America. Our vision is to be the employer, supplier and investment of choice. We transform renewable resources into papers that people depend on for education, communication and entertainment. Headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee, we employ more than 6,500 colleagues. Net sales for 2025 were $3.4 billion. For more information, please visit[Sylvamo.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sylvamo.com%2F&esheet=54613761&newsitemid=20261006816749&lan=en-US&anchor=Sylvamo.com&index=4&md5=18996582800df9578f72516c26b2d0d8) .
